qs.q: Why are they shopping?
What did the narrator buy?

qs.q: What does he say about the wife's hat?

gram.t: 穿 vs 戴 — two kinds of wearing
gram.d: 穿 for things you step or slip INTO: 穿襯衫, 穿外套, 穿襪子, 穿鞋. 戴 for things that sit ON you: 戴帽子, 戴眼鏡, 戴手錶, 戴口罩. Mix them up and locals will smile — sort them and you sound trained.

qs.q: What color is the new tie?
What does Xiao Chen say about the beard?
ch: Shave daily to look like a professional engineer

qs.q: What's planned for next week?

gram.t: adjective + 一點 — a bit more
gram.d: Tack 一點 after an adjective for 'a bit -er': 帥一點 a bit sharper, 快一點 hurry up a bit, 便宜一點 a little cheaper (bargaining!). Requests soften instantly: 小聲一點 keep it down a little.

readings.title: 故事⑤：還麵錢 Story ⑤: Repaying the Bowl

qs.q: How does the narrator try to repay the debt?
What is grandpa's rule?
ch: Noodle debts can't be repaid with money

qs.q: What does the granddaughter write in the ledger?

gram.d: 連 fronts the extreme case, 都 seals it: 連我老婆都哭了 even my wife cried. 連週末都要工作 even weekends are workdays. 連一塊錢都沒有 not even a single dollar. Your emphasis heavy-lifter for OPI storytelling.

readings.title: 參展申請 The Expo Application

qs.q: What did the company decide to apply for?
ch: Exhibiting at October's aerospace and defense expo

qs.q: Besides preparing products, what else is needed?
What is the flagship product?
ch: The new-generation drone with longer endurance and simpler operation

gram.t: 除了…以外，還… — besides X, also Y
gram.d: 除了 + known thing + 以外, 還 + the addition: 除了產品以外，還要設計文宣。 Besides the products, we also need materials. Swap 還 for 都 and the meaning flips to 'except': 除了他以外，大家都來了 everyone came except him. One frame, two meanings — watch the second half.

readings.title: 無人機產業的舞台 The Drone Industry's Stage

qs.q: What has become the focus of the expo?
What dual markets do many products target?
Why do analysts see Taiwan as well positioned?

gram.d: 既 + ability A, 也 + ability B, one subject doing double duty: 既能協助救災，也能執行巡邏任務。 Can both assist disaster relief and run patrols. The formal sibling of 又…又… — analysis writing loves it for dual-use, dual-benefit framing.

dict.py: Liúhǎi búyào jiǎn tài duǎn.

dict.py: Pángbiān bāng wǒ dǎbáo yìdiǎn.

dict.py: Xǐ wán tóu, wǒ bāng nín chuīgān.

pass.zh: 歡迎！今天想怎麼剪呢？喔，下週要簽約喔？那我建議兩邊打薄，上面留一點長度，瀏海往旁邊吹，看起來又精神又專業。剪完我幫你吹乾，教你怎麼整理，三分鐘就好。

dict.py: Gōngsī juédìng shēnqǐng cānzhǎn.

dict.zh: 這個展的檔期是十月中。

pass.zh: 參展的分工：小美負責跟主辦單位聯絡，確認檔期跟位置。文宣交給設計公司，下週三看第一版。展示影片用上次董事長參觀拍的，再加新機型的畫面。主打就一個重點：續航更長，操作更簡單。

qs.q: What is Xiaomei responsible for?
ch: Contacting the organizers about the slot and location

qs.q: What is the single flagship message?

dict.zh: 這次展覽預計有上百家廠商參展。
dict.py: Zhè cì zhǎnlǎn yùjì yǒu shàng bǎi jiā chǎngshāng cānzhǎn.
dict.en: Over a hundred manufacturers are expected to exhibit.

dict.zh: 多款新機型將首次亮相。
dict.py: Duō kuǎn xīn jīxíng jiāng shǒucì liàngxiàng.
dict.en: Several new models will make their first appearance.

dict.zh: 產品同時瞄準軍用與商用市場。
dict.py: Chǎnpǐn tóngshí miáozhǔn jūnyòng yǔ shāngyòng shìchǎng.
dict.en: Products target both military and commercial markets.

dict.zh: 這個平台既能救災，也能巡邏。
dict.py: Zhège píngtái jì néng jiùzāi, yě néng xúnluó.
dict.en: This platform can both do disaster relief and patrol.

dict.zh: 台灣的供應鏈相當完整。
dict.py: Táiwān de gōngyìngliàn xiāngdāng wánzhěng.
dict.en: Taiwan's supply chain is quite complete.

pass.zh: 產業觀察：十月的航太國防展，無人機是最大焦點。趨勢有兩個：第一，軍用跟商用的界線越來越模糊，同一個平台，改一改就能換市場。第二，客戶越來越重視續航跟整合能力。對台灣廠商來說，這是把技術變成訂單的最好舞台。

qs.q: What is the first trend mentioned?
ch: The military-commercial line is blurring — one platform adapts to both markets

qs.q: What do customers increasingly value?

scenarios.intro: Department store, Saturday afternoon. Your wife is the stylist, you are the mannequin. Cooperate and look sharp.

them.zh: 這件白襯衫你穿穿看！
them.py: Zhè jiàn bái chènshān nǐ chuānchuān kàn!
them.en: Try this white shirt on!

turns.task: Try it — it fits well and feels comfortable.

ans.zh: 很合身，穿起來很舒服！
ans.py: Hěn héshēn, chuān qǐlái hěn shūfú!
ans.en: Fits great — really comfortable on!

them.zh: 好看！再配一件外套，更專業。
them.py: Hǎokàn! Zài pèi yí jiàn wàitào, gèng zhuānyè.
them.en: Handsome! Add a jacket — more professional.

turns.task: Agree — ask if the dark blue jacket works.

ans.zh: 好啊，這件深藍色的外套可以嗎？
ans.py: Hǎo a, zhè jiàn shēnlánsè de wàitào kěyǐ ma?
ans.en: Sure — does this dark blue jacket work?

them.zh: 可以！襪子也要買新的，舊的都有洞了！
them.py: Kěyǐ! Wàzi yě yào mǎi xīn de, jiù de dōu yǒu dòng le!
them.en: Yes! And buy new socks — your old ones all have holes!

turns.task: Guilty. Take three pairs of black socks.

ans.zh: 哈哈好，我拿三雙黑色的襪子。
ans.py: Hāhā hǎo, wǒ ná sān shuāng hēisè de wàzi.
ans.en: Haha fine — I'll grab three pairs of black socks.

them.zh: 你看我戴這頂帽子怎麼樣？
them.py: Nǐ kàn wǒ dài zhè dǐng màozi zěnmeyàng?
them.en: How do I look in this hat?

turns.task: She looks great in anything — buy it for her.

ans.zh: 你戴什麼都好看！這頂我買給你！
ans.py: Nǐ dài shénme dōu hǎokàn! Zhè dǐng wǒ mǎi gěi nǐ!
ans.en: You look great in anything! I'm buying you this one!

them.zh: 你嘴真甜！好啦，去付錢吧！
them.py: Nǐ zuǐ zhēn tián! Hǎo la, qù fù qián ba!
them.en: Such a sweet talker! OK — go pay!

turns.task: Off to the register — today's shopping was a success.

ans.zh: 走！今天買得很成功！
ans.py: Zǒu! Jīntiān mǎi de hěn chénggōng!
ans.en: Let's go! Today's shopping was a total success!

scenarios.intro: Xiao Chen has appointed himself your image consultant for signing day. He has thoughts about ties, beards, and photos.

them.zh: 哇，新皮鞋！要簽約了，準備得很認真喔！
them.py: Wā, xīn píxié! Yào qiānyuē le, zhǔnbèi de hěn rènzhēn ō!
them.en: Whoa, new leather shoes! Taking signing day seriously!

turns.task: Of course — you also bought a blue tie that matches the shirt.

ans.zh: 當然！我還買了一條藍色的領帶，跟襯衫很搭。
ans.py: Dāngrán! Wǒ hái mǎi le yì tiáo lánsè de lǐngdài, gēn chènshān hěn dā.
ans.en: Of course! I also got a blue tie that matches the shirt.

them.zh: 不錯不錯！那鬍子呢？不要又忘記刮！
them.py: Búcuò búcuò! Nà húzi ne? Búyào yòu wàngjì guā!
them.en: Nice! And the beard? Don't forget to shave again!

turns.task: That was ONE time — you'll shave every day this week.

ans.zh: 就那麼一次！這個星期我每天都刮鬍子啦！
ans.py: Jiù nàme yí cì! Zhège xīngqí wǒ měitiān dōu guā húzi la!
ans.en: That was ONE time! I'm shaving every day this week!

them.zh: 哈哈！頭髮呢？要不要去剪一下？
them.py: Hāhā! Tóufǎ ne? Yào bú yào qù jiǎn yíxià?
them.en: Haha! And the hair? Getting it cut?

turns.task: Already booked — haircut next week, right before the trip.

ans.zh: 約好了，下週去剪頭髮，剛好在出差以前。
ans.py: Yuē hǎo le, xià zhōu qù jiǎn tóufǎ, gānghǎo zài chūchāi yǐqián.
ans.en: Booked — haircut next week, right before the trip.

them.zh: 完美！簽約那天我們一起穿白襯衫，拍照一定很帥！
them.py: Wánměi! Qiānyuē nà tiān wǒmen yìqǐ chuān bái chènshān, pāizhào yídìng hěn shuài!
them.en: Perfect! Matching white shirts on signing day — the photos will be so sharp!

turns.task: Deal — and Mr. Wang can take the photo.

ans.zh: 好主意！照片請王先生幫我們拍！
ans.py: Hǎo zhǔyì! Zhàopiàn qǐng Wáng xiānshēng bāng wǒmen pāi!
ans.en: Great idea! We'll ask Mr. Wang to take the photo!

them.zh: 哈哈他一定說：年輕人真愛拍照！
them.py: Hāhā tā yídìng shuō: niánqīngrén zhēn ài pāizhào!
them.en: Haha, he'll definitely say: you youngsters and your photos!

turns.task: Laugh — important days deserve a good photo.

ans.zh: 哈哈，重要的日子，當然要拍一張好照片！
ans.py: Hāhā, zhòngyào de rìzi, dāngrán yào pāi yì zhāng hǎo zhàopiàn!
ans.en: Haha — big days deserve a good photo!

scenarios.intro: The chair, the cape, the mirror. Describe the cut you want in Mandarin — the ultimate real-life language test.

them.zh: 歡迎！今天想怎麼剪呢？
them.py: Huānyíng! Jīntiān xiǎng zěnme jiǎn ne?
them.en: Welcome! How would you like it today?

turns.task: You have a big event next week — you want a new, more professional look.

ans.zh: 下週有重要的活動，我想換一個比較專業的造型。
ans.py: Xià zhōu yǒu zhòngyào de huódòng, wǒ xiǎng huàn yí ge bǐjiào zhuānyè de zàoxíng.
ans.en: I have an important event next week — I'd like a more professional look.

them.zh: 了解！兩邊要不要打薄？現在有點厚。
them.py: Liǎojiě! Liǎngbiān yào bú yào dǎbáo? Xiànzài yǒudiǎn hòu.
them.en: Got it! Thin out the sides? They're a bit thick now.

turns.task: Yes, thin the sides — but keep some length on top.

ans.zh: 好，旁邊打薄，可是上面留一點長度。
ans.py: Hǎo, pángbiān dǎbáo, kěshì shàngmiàn liú yìdiǎn chángdù.
ans.en: Yes — thin the sides, but leave some length on top.

them.zh: 瀏海呢？要剪短還是往旁邊撥？
them.py: Liúhǎi ne? Yào jiǎn duǎn háishì wǎng pángbiān bō?
them.en: And the bangs? Cut short or swept to the side?

turns.task: Swept aside — don't cut them too short.

ans.zh: 往旁邊就好，瀏海不要剪太短。
ans.py: Wǎng pángbiān jiù hǎo, liúhǎi búyào jiǎn tài duǎn.
ans.en: Swept aside is fine — don't cut the bangs too short.

them.zh: 沒問題！剪完幫您吹乾，順便教您怎麼整理。
them.py: Méi wèntí! Jiǎn wán bāng nín chuīgān, shùnbiàn jiāo nín zěnme zhěnglǐ.
them.en: No problem! After the cut I'll blow-dry it and show you how to style it.

turns.task: Great — ask if it's easy to manage on busy mornings.

ans.zh: 太好了！請問早上忙的時候，好整理嗎？
ans.py: Tài hǎo le! Qǐngwèn zǎoshàng máng de shíhòu, hǎo zhěnglǐ ma?
ans.en: Perfect! Is it easy to manage on busy mornings?

them.zh: 三分鐘就好！吹一吹、抓一抓，出門！
them.py: Sān fēnzhōng jiù hǎo! Chuī yì chuī, zhuā yì zhuā, chūmén!
them.en: Three minutes! Quick blow-dry, quick tousle, out the door!

turns.task: Sold — let's do it.

ans.zh: 聽起來很棒，那就這樣剪吧！
ans.py: Tīng qǐlái hěn bàng, nà jiù zhèyàng jiǎn ba!
ans.en: Sounds great — let's do it!

scenarios.intro: The expo application is greenlit. Xiaomei has the checklist open and is assigning lanes. Claim yours.

them.zh: 參展確定了！你看過主辦單位的資料了嗎？
them.py: Cānzhǎn quèdìng le! Nǐ kàn guò zhǔbàn dānwèi de zīliào le ma?
them.en: The exhibit is confirmed! Did you see the organizer's info?

turns.task: Yes — the slot is mid-October, right after the signing, the timing is perfect.

ans.zh: 看了，檔期是十月中，剛好在簽約之後，時間很完美。
ans.py: Kàn le, dǎngqí shì shí yuè zhōng, gānghǎo zài qiānyuē zhīhòu, shíjiān hěn wánměi.
ans.en: Yes — the slot is mid-October, right after the signing. Perfect timing.

them.zh: 文宣的部分，設計公司下週三給第一版，你可以幫忙看嗎？
them.py: Wénxuān de bùfèn, shèjì gōngsī xià zhōusān gěi dì yī bǎn, nǐ kěyǐ bāngmáng kàn ma?
them.en: On the materials — the design firm delivers a first draft next Wednesday. Can you review?

turns.task: Yes — you'll check that the technical specs in the materials are accurate.

ans.zh: 可以，我會確認文宣上的技術規格都正確。
ans.py: Kěyǐ, wǒ huì quèrèn wénxuān shàng de jìshù guīgé dōu zhèngquè.
ans.en: Sure — I'll make sure the technical specs in the materials are accurate.

them.zh: 展示的重點呢？我們東西很多，不能全部帶。
them.py: Zhǎnshì de zhòngdiǎn ne? Wǒmen dōngxi hěn duō, bùnéng quánbù dài.
them.en: And the display focus? We have a lot — we can't bring everything.

turns.task: One flagship: the new-generation drone — longer endurance, simpler operation.

ans.zh: 主打一個就好：新一代的無人機，續航更長，操作更簡單。
ans.py: Zhǔdǎ yí ge jiù hǎo: xīn yí dài de wúrénjī, xùháng gèng cháng, cāozuò gèng jiǎndān.
ans.en: One flagship is enough: the new-gen drone — longer endurance, simpler operation.

them.zh: 同意！影片呢？重新拍嗎？
them.py: Tóngyì! Yǐngpiàn ne? Chóngxīn pāi ma?
them.en: Agreed! And the video? Shoot a new one?

turns.task: Reuse the chairman-visit footage, plus new shots of the new model — saves time and money.

ans.zh: 用董事長參觀那次拍的，再加新機型的畫面，省時間也省錢。
ans.py: Yòng dǒngshìzhǎng cānguān nà cì pāi de, zài jiā xīn jīxíng de huàmiàn, shěng shíjiān yě shěng qián.
ans.en: Use the chairman-visit footage plus new-model shots — saves time and money.

them.zh: 太好了，那分工就這樣定了。十月我們一起讓大家看看！
them.py: Tài hǎo le, nà fēngōng jiù zhèyàng dìng le. Shí yuè wǒmen yìqǐ ràng dàjiā kànkan!
them.en: Great — the assignments are set. In October we show everyone what we've got!

turns.task: Fired up — first the signing, then the expo: a big autumn.

ans.zh: 沒錯！先簽約，再參展——今年秋天很精彩！
ans.py: Méicuò! Xiān qiānyuē, zài cānzhǎn — jīnnián qiūtiān hěn jīngcǎi!
ans.en: Exactly! First the signing, then the expo — what an autumn!

scenarios.intro: Door closed, whiteboard out. The boss wants the expo positioning nailed: which market, which message, which moment.

them.zh: 十月的展，我們的定位是什麼？軍用還是商用？
them.py: Shí yuè de zhǎn, wǒmen de dìngwèi shì shénme? Jūnyòng háishì shāngyòng?
them.en: October's expo — our positioning? Military or commercial?

turns.task: Both — the same platform serves disaster relief and patrol missions; the line between markets is blurring.

ans.zh: 兩個都要。同一個平台既能救災，也能巡邏，軍用跟商用的界線越來越模糊。
ans.py: Liǎng ge dōu yào. Tóng yí ge píngtái jì néng jiùzāi, yě néng xúnluó, jūnyòng gēn shāngyòng de jièxiàn yuè lái yuè móhú.
ans.en: Both. The same platform handles disaster relief and patrol — the military-commercial line keeps blurring.

them.zh: 新機型要在展上首次亮相嗎？還是先保密？
them.py: Xīn jīxíng yào zài zhǎn shàng shǒucì liàngxiàng ma? Háishì xiān bǎomì?
them.en: Should the new model debut at the expo — or stay under wraps?

turns.task: Debut it — a first appearance draws media and clients; the expo is the best stage.

ans.zh: 讓它亮相。首次亮相最能吸引媒體跟客戶，展覽就是最好的舞台。
ans.py: Ràng tā liàngxiàng. Shǒucì liàngxiàng zuì néng xīyǐn méitǐ gēn kèhù, zhǎnlǎn jiùshì zuì hǎo de wǔtái.
ans.en: Debut it. A first appearance draws media and clients best — the expo is the perfect stage.

them.zh: 跟其他上百家廠商比，我們的優勢在哪裡？
them.py: Gēn qítā shàng bǎi jiā chǎngshāng bǐ, wǒmen de yōushì zài nǎlǐ?
them.en: Against a hundred other exhibitors — where's our edge?

turns.task: Proven results: the chairman's deal shows real orders, and Taiwan's complete supply chain backs delivery.

ans.zh: 我們有實績。跟董事長的合作代表真實的訂單，加上台灣完整的供應鏈，交貨有保障。
ans.py: Wǒmen yǒu shíjì. Gēn dǒngshìzhǎng de hézuò dàibiǎo zhēnshí de dìngdān, jiāshàng Táiwān wánzhěng de gōngyìngliàn, jiāohuò yǒu bǎozhàng.
ans.en: We have a track record — the chairman deal means real orders, and Taiwan's complete supply chain guarantees delivery.

them.zh: 如果現場有政府單位來詢問，誰負責接待？
them.py: Rúguǒ xiànchǎng yǒu zhèngfǔ dānwèi lái xúnwèn, shéi fùzé jiēdài?
them.en: If government units come asking at the booth — who handles them?

turns.task: Suggest: the boss leads those talks; you support with technical answers — government cases need senior-level reception.

ans.zh: 建議由您親自談，我在旁邊負責技術的部分。政府的案子，需要高層級的接待。
ans.py: Jiànyì yóu nín qīnzì tán, wǒ zài pángbiān fùzé jìshù de bùfèn. Zhèngfǔ de ànzi, xūyào gāo céngjí de jiēdài.
ans.en: You should lead those talks, with me on technical support — government cases need senior-level reception.

them.zh: 好。那就用一句話總結我們的參展目標吧。
them.py: Hǎo. Nà jiù yòng yí jù huà zǒngjié wǒmen de cānzhǎn mùbiāo ba.
them.en: Good. Now sum up our expo goal in one sentence.

turns.task: One sentence: turn technology into orders, and turn the expo into next year's growth.

ans.zh: 一句話：把技術變成訂單，把展覽變成明年的成長。
ans.py: Yí jù huà: bǎ jìshù biàn chéng dìngdān, bǎ zhǎnlǎn biàn chéng míngnián de chéngzhǎng.
ans.en: One sentence: turn technology into orders, and turn the expo into next year's growth.

x: 她戴了一頂帽子。
Tā dài le yì dǐng màozi.
She put on a hat.
vocab.n: Measure word 頂. Verb is 戴, never 穿. 安全帽 = helmet — legally required on every scooter in Taiwan.

x: 再買一件外套吧。
Zài mǎi yí jiàn wàitào ba.
Let's get a jacket too.
vocab.n: 外 outer + 套 covering. Taiwan essential: fierce AC indoors means 帶件外套 even in August.

x: 我買了三雙黑色的襪子。
Wǒ mǎi le sān shuāng hēisè de wàzi.
I bought three pairs of black socks.
vocab.n: Measure word 雙 (pair). 穿襪子 wear socks — and yes, take shoes AND consider socks status before entering a Taiwanese home.

x: 我穿了一件白襯衫。
Wǒ chuān le yí jiàn bái chènshān.
I wore a white shirt.
vocab.n: The business staple. 白襯衫 is the default signing-day answer. Casual tee is T恤 — different world.

x: 新皮鞋跟襯衫很搭。
Xīn píxié gēn chènshān hěn dā.
The new leather shoes match the shirt.
vocab.n: 皮 leather + 鞋 shoes. 球鞋 sneakers, 拖鞋 slippers, 高跟鞋 heels — the 鞋 lineup.

x: 我買了一條藍色的領帶。
Wǒ mǎi le yì tiáo lánsè de lǐngdài.
I bought a blue tie.
vocab.n: 領 collar + 帶 strap; measure word 條. 打領帶 = to tie/wear a tie — the verb is 打, a fun collocation.

x: 每天都要刮鬍子。
Měitiān dōu yào guā húzi.
Shave every day.
vocab.n: 刮 scrape + 鬍子 beard. 刮鬍刀 razor. 留鬍子 = growing it out — the opposite lifestyle.

x: 我下週要去剪頭髮。
Wǒ xià zhōu yào qù jiǎn tóufǎ.
I'm getting a haircut next week.
vocab.n: 剪 cut + 頭髮 hair. Both directions: you 剪頭髮 at the salon, the stylist 幫你剪. Shortened: 剪髮.

x: 我想換一個新造型。
Wǒ xiǎng huàn yí ge xīn zàoxíng.
I want a new look.
vocab.n: Hair, outfits, even product design (產品造型). 造型師 = stylist. 換造型 = the makeover verb.

x: 瀏海不要剪太短。
Liúhǎi búyào jiǎn tài duǎn.
Don't cut the bangs too short.
vocab.n: The one word that prevents salon disasters. 剪瀏海 trim bangs, 留瀏海 grow them out, 空氣瀏海 wispy 'air bangs' — Taiwan salon-menu regular.

x: 旁邊幫我打薄一點。
Pángbiān bāng wǒ dǎbáo yìdiǎn.
Thin out the sides a bit.
vocab.n: 打 + 薄 thin: reducing bulk without length. Summer-in-Taiwan salon request #1. Same 打 as 打領帶 — the do-anything verb.

x: 洗完頭，我幫您吹乾。
Xǐ wán tóu, wǒ bāng nín chuīgān.
After the wash, I'll blow-dry it.
vocab.n: 吹 blow + 乾 dry — a resultative verb: the blowing achieves dryness. 吹風機 hair dryer. Pattern-mates: 擦乾 towel dry, 洗乾淨 wash clean.

x: 公司決定申請參展。
Gōngsī juédìng shēnqǐng cānzhǎn.
The company decided to apply to exhibit.
vocab.n: 參加 + 展覽 compressed. 參展廠商 exhibitors, 參展證 exhibitor badge. Your side of the booth; visitors merely 看展.

x: 新的文宣下週定稿。
Xīn de wénxuān xià zhōu dìnggǎo.
The new materials are finalized next week.
vocab.n: 文字 + 宣傳: brochures, flyers, banners. Also political: 競選文宣 campaign literature. The stuff on every expo table.

x: 主打的產品是新一代無人機。
Zhǔdǎ de chǎnpǐn shì xīn yí dài wúrénjī.
The flagship product is the new-gen drone.
vocab.n: 主 main + 打 push: 主打產品 flagship product, 主打歌 an album's lead single. What you lead with.

x: 這個展的檔期是十月中。
Zhège zhǎn de dǎngqí shì shí yuè zhōng.
The expo's slot is mid-October.
vocab.n: Expos, movie releases, ad campaigns, venue bookings — anything that occupies a calendar window. 喬檔期 = juggling schedules.

x: 十月有航太國防展。
Shí yuè yǒu hángtài guófáng zhǎn.
There's an aerospace and defense expo in October.
vocab.n: 航空 aviation + 太空 space, compressed. 航太產業 aerospace industry, 航太工程 aerospace engineering — your sector's headline word.

x: 這款產品瞄準軍用市場。
Zhè kuǎn chǎnpǐn miáozhǔn jūnyòng shìchǎng.
This product targets the military market.
vocab.n: 軍 military + 用 use. 軍用規格 mil-spec. The 用-series: 軍用/商用/民用 military/commercial/civilian — procurement's three lanes.

x: 軍用跟商用的界線越來越模糊。
Jūnyòng gēn shāngyòng de jièxiàn yuè lái yuè móhú.
The line between military and commercial use keeps blurring.
vocab.n: 商 commerce + 用. 商用無人機 commercial drones, 商用不動產 commercial real estate. Pairs with 軍用 in every dual-use discussion.

vocab.e: to make a public debut, be unveiled
x: 新機型將首次亮相。
Xīn jīxíng jiāng shǒucì liàngxiàng.
The new model will make its first public appearance.
vocab.n: 亮 bright + 相 appearance — from opera actors striking their entrance pose. 首次亮相 first unveiling: products, candidates, even babies on social media.

x: 你這雙新皮鞋有點潮喔！
Nǐ zhè shuāng xīn píxié yǒudiǎn cháo ō!
Those new shoes are pretty stylish!
slang.n: Literally 'tide' — riding the fashion current. 潮牌 streetwear brands, 潮男潮女 trendy guys and girls. Overdone? 太潮了 can turn teasing.

x: 剪完頭髮，整個人超有型！
Jiǎn wán tóufǎ, zhěngge rén chāo yǒuxíng!
After the haircut, you look seriously sharp!
slang.n: 型 form/shape: having a distinct look. More about presence than trends — a well-cut jacket is 有型 forever.

x: 這條領帶會不會太土？
Zhè tiáo lǐngdài huì bú huì tài tǔ?
Is this tie too dorky?
slang.n: Literally 'dirt/earth' — style stuck in the countryside. 土味 cheesy vibes. Friendly roast between friends; the opposite of 潮.

slang.e: wearing the same outfit as someone (outfit collision)
x: 我們簽約那天都穿白襯衫，故意撞衫啦！
Wǒmen qiānyuē nà tiān dōu chuān bái chènshān, gùyì zhuàngshān la!
We're both wearing white shirts on signing day — an intentional outfit collision!
slang.n: 撞 crash + 衫 shirt: two people, one look. Usually awkward (撞衫最怕比輸 the real fear is losing the comparison) — unless it's on purpose.

x: 「你戴什麼都好看」——哇，很會撩喔！
"Nǐ dài shénme dōu hǎokàn" — wā, hěn huì liáo ō!
'You look great in anything' — wow, smooth talker!
slang.n: 撩 to tease/stir: charming someone with smooth lines. 撩妹/撩漢 flirting with girls/guys, 情話撩人 sweet talk that lands. 很會撩 = certified smooth.
